name: print-social-house-warming-stories-blue-white-flat-illustration-testimonial
title: 'Warm Welcome Guaranteed' house warming story set in blue and white with flat illustration and a client photo testimonial

techniques: Mix flat illustration with real testimonial photography.
List services as a simple checklist for clarity.
Alternate blue and white cards for rhythm across a set.
